about.hero_subtitle: A journey through time, art, and the legacy of a nation's cultural heart.
about.content_quote: Our theater was established with the aim of raising the spirituality of youth and children, and introducing them to culture.
about.content_p1: The first works staged at the beginning of the last century were mainly based on folk tales and heroic epics. Over the years, the theater's repertoire expanded, filled with masterpieces of Uzbek classical literature, as well as examples of world drama.
about.content_p2: During the years of World War II, the theater team encouraged the youth with their patriotic works not only in their own lands, but also behind the front. With the years of independence, the theater found its new breath. Plays prioritized national values were staged, and all conditions were created for the free creativity of young actors and directors.
about.content_p3: Today, our theater has its prestige not only at home, but also in the international arena. The troupe participates in a number of prestigious international festivals, winning honorable places. The building, equipped with the most modern stage technologies and lighting designs, is always crowded with fans.
about.timeline_1_desc: The theater was founded, becoming one of the first professional theaters dedicated to young audiences.
about.timeline_2_desc: The theater received official state recognition and was reorganized as a state theater for young spectators.
about.timeline_3_desc: After WWII, the theater underwent a creative renaissance, staging powerful patriotic and humanistic works that inspired a generation.
about.timeline_4_desc: A brand new, purpose-built theater was erected with modern stage technology, significantly expanding the theater's artistic possibilities.
about.timeline_5_desc: With Uzbekistan's independence, the theater embraced national identity, staging works rooted in Uzbek culture and values.
about.timeline_6_desc: The theater began participating in prestigious international festivals, earning awards and establishing partnerships with global theater communities.
about.timeline_7_desc: Celebrating over a century of art, the theater continues its mission of inspiring young hearts through the power of performance.
about.history_intro: For over a century, our theater has been a beacon of art, culture, and education — shaping generations of young minds through the transformative power of live performance.
about.history_section_1_text: In its earliest days, amid sweeping winds of change, a group of passionate artists and educators came together with a bold vision: to create a theater that would speak directly to the hearts and minds of young audiences. From the very start, the theater drew upon a rich tapestry of folklore, heroic epics, and timeless moral tales to craft performances that were both entertaining and deeply meaningful.
about.history_section_2_text: During the challenging years of World War II, the theater's troupe did not retreat from its mission. Instead, they traveled to the front lines and hospitals, performing for soldiers and civilians alike. Their patriotic works boosted morale and reminded audiences of the enduring power of art even in the darkest times. This period forged the theater's identity as an institution of resilience and purpose.
about.history_section_3_text: The dawn of independence in 1991 ushered in a new golden age. The theater embraced its national roots while opening its doors to the world. Collaborations with international directors, participation in global festivals, and the introduction of cutting-edge stage technology transformed the theater into a truly world-class institution — without ever losing the warmth and intimacy that define its relationship with young audiences.
about.partners_intro: We are proud to work alongside organizations that share our commitment to art, education, and the cultural development of future generations.
